title: Miss Benzo Lyricism Shines With Her Recent Release “Cycles”
htmlContent:
Born in Canada and raised in Las Vegas, Mercedes Cameron, also known as Miss Benzo, is a Virtuoso singer and songwriter who have mastered the art of taking their sounds to new heights and crossing over into different genres to give their audience what they need with a focus on creating beautiful, catchy and meaningful songs. The songstress does not play around when expressing her emotions, especially with her recent single "Cycles."

Miss Benzo's "Cycles" is inspired by "Stan" by Eminem & "Too Much" by Lakeyah with a confrontational storytelling approach. With a perfect mix of vocals and lyricism, she intends to give the audience the whole experience. Her sound is smooth, direct, and forward-thinking, making for a compelling and timeless feel with a massive touch of Soul and R&B. The record brings an authentic approach with the perfect blend of a golden age feel in the rhyming to make a work of art for the culture to thrive.
